message.content:
This editorial illustration features an orange cover for "TEMPO" magazine. At the top, a red rounded rectangle contains the white text "EDISI KHUSUS AKHIR TAHUN". Below the large black title "TEMPO" is smaller white text: "EDISI 29 Desember 2003-4 Januari 2004". Further down, black text reads "2004: Ketika Presiden Dipilih Langsung". The main illustration depicts several cartoon figures in a state of chaotic motion against a background of radiating yellow lines.

A central figure in a purple dress or suit is shown falling backward, her arms and legs outstretched. Surrounding her are multiple figures in dark suits. To the left, a large, hunched figure with a beard reaches toward the center. Below the central figure, a person in a black hat is depicted falling. To the right, several suited figures appear to be pushing, pulling, or shouting, with their limbs tangled in various directions. One figure at the bottom center is being gripped by another. The figures have exaggerated facial expressions of anger, surprise, or distress. A barcode and price are visible at the bottom left and right. At the bottom center, small blue text reads "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN".
